note.en: A small rocky-shore top snail recorded at the Cahuita National Park station in 1998 and at Limón. Only a regional record.
note.es: Un caracol trompo pequeño de orilla rocosa registrado en la estación del Parque Nacional Cahuita en 1998 y en Limón. Es solo un registro regional.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
